roleContext.jobDescription: The commercial lending credit risk reporting team produces the portfolio risk reports for the bank's credit committee and the regulator. The Credit Risk Reporting Analyst builds and runs the monthly portfolio reports from the lending data, reconciles them to the general ledger, investigates the movements the credit committee questions, presents the report walk-through to the committee secretariat, and documents each report's limitations. The role requires explaining report movements to senior stakeholders under questioning. Reports to the head of credit risk reporting; works with the credit committee secretariat, finance and the data platform team.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Credit Risk Reporting Analyst, Commercial Lending

## Experience

- Credit risk reporting analyst in a commercial bank's credit risk reporting team for four years, building and running the monthly portfolio risk reports from the lending data under the bank's reporting standard.
- Reconciled the monthly reports to the general ledger with finance, with the reconciliation sign-off recorded each month in the reporting log.
- Investigated the report movements the credit committee questioned and presented the walk-through to the committee secretariat each month; the secretariat's minutes record the questions asked and the explanations accepted for the twenty-three walk-throughs I presented.
- Coordinated the lending data changes with the data platform team through the data change log, recording which validations were mine and which were the platform team's.
- Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each monthly report.

## Work samples

- Work sample: one monthly portfolio risk report with its reconciliation sign-off and limitation section, and the secretariat minutes for two walk-throughs, with the reporting log references as a verification trail.
